subject: reasoning
question:
Which letter-cluster will replace the question mark (?) to complete the given series?

GJLD, ?, KZPT, MURO, OPTJ
solution:
According to the English alphabets and their positional values:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a7d12502c2ca7d9724c6b72807e815218baf7d8f4c343b106b5314067691645b.png] 

The pattern followed in the given series is:

 First and third alphabets are increased to 2 positional values.

 Second and fourth alphabets are decreased by 5 positional values.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/52ac7a9e6db31b61bd1c5ba6fb4594347a1808fbf58f2b876f36430550453987.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is "option (2)".
